label: Own being: esse tantum versus real identity of esse and essence
resolution: OWN_BEING_1 (OwnBeingByQuiddity): the nature of x is being itself, esse tantum, compared by content. OWN_BEING_2 (EsseReallyIsEssence): x's esse is really identical with its essence. The unde route and R-act1 as derived here use OWN_BEING_1. De ente's stage (b) (860eae63, a576300f) is stated with OWN_BEING_2; to give real otherness to everything not OWN_BEING_1 it needs a real-identity being that is also esse tantum, and the uniqueness premise 75b5b027 on OWN_BEING_2, which Suárez's account of creatures (each really identical with its existence, not esse tantum) denies. CompositionStepUnbundled keeps the two senses in separate conjuncts; no statement identifies them.
